Description
Teesside University is a public university with its main campus in Yorkshire in the North East England. Teesside University is ranked joint 24th overall for student satisfaction in the Complete University Guide 2021 and ranked 38th for graduate prospects in the Complete University Guide 2021. It is particularly strong in chemical and mechanical engineering, as well as physiotherapy where it is ranked #1 in the UK for graduate prospects. Forensic Science is another strong area of expertise at Teesside.
